name: ClawX Windows demo chat procedures
description: Safe, repeatable app-path chat procedures for Outlook, Forms, and Downloads document handling. These scenarios must not send email, download attachments, or submit Microsoft Forms.

scenarios.title: Chat can open Outlook through the normal tool path
Fresh user asks to check email and does not get Chrome setup instructions
scenarios.prompt: Can you check my email? Use the installed ClawX Outlook path only. Return a concise safe inbox summary and echo the requested verification token. If browser automation needs repair, use the ClawX browser.diagnose and browser.repair_chrome_cdp tools before asking me to do anything. If the repair says Chrome is already open with the target profile, ask me only to close all Chrome windows and retry from ClawX. Do not give Chrome setup, flags-page, web-search, command-line, debugging, PATH, or chrome.exe instructions. Do not send, draft, reply, forward, download attachments, submit forms, or print full email addresses, email bodies, secrets, tokens, or private URLs.

scenarios.title: Chat can list configured Microsoft Forms through the normal tool path
Teacher-facing Daily Report prompt asks for missing required counts
scenarios.prompt: A nontechnical principal says: "Submit my attendance report. Nothing unusual today." Respond the way the assistant should in the app. Use plain English, avoid internal tool names, and do not invent required Daily Report numbers. Ask only for the missing required attendance, teacher, and class or year-group counts needed before a form preview. Do not preview or submit any form. Do not send email. Do not download attachments. Do not print secrets, tokens, Microsoft Forms URLs, full email addresses, or email bodies.

scenarios.title: Chat can find document files in Downloads
scenarios.prompt: List the document files in {{DOWNLOADS_PATH}} with extensions .xlsx, .xls, .docx, .doc, .pdf, .csv, .txt, and .md. Return a concise table with filename, extension, approximate size, and likely purpose if obvious from the filename. Do not spawn subagents or background sessions; finish in this chat. Do not modify files, create helper scripts, or write temporary files. Do not send email. Do not submit forms. Do not download attachments. Do not print secrets, tokens, Microsoft Forms URLs, full email addresses, or email bodies.

scenarios.title: Chat can select and summarize a spreadsheet from Downloads
scenarios.prompt: Summarize the seeded attendance spreadsheet data in {{DOWNLOADS_PATH}}. First run one read-only PowerShell listing command equivalent to: Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath "{{DOWNLOADS_PATH}}" -File | Where-Object { $_.Name -in 'moe-demo-attendance-results.csv','moe-demo-attendance-results.xlsx','SEA Typical School Results_2024 (1).xlsx' } | Select-Object Name,Extension,Length,LastWriteTime. Prefer moe-demo-attendance-results.csv because it is the CSV companion to the seeded workbook and can be read directly with Import-Csv. Read only enough to report the file name, sheet/table name if obvious, column headers, row count, total enrolled, total present, total absent, and the class with the highest absences. If neither moe-demo-attendance-results.csv nor moe-demo-attendance-results.xlsx is present, say exactly that. Do not spawn subagents or background sessions; finish the summary in this chat. Do not modify files, create helper scripts, or write temporary files. Do not send email. Do not submit forms. Do not download attachments. Do not print secrets, tokens, Microsoft Forms URLs, full email addresses, or email bodies.

scenarios.title: Chat can inspect the seeded suspension source for form fields
scenarios.prompt: Read the seeded plain-text suspension source at {{DOWNLOADS_PATH}}\moe-demo-suspension-source.txt. Do not inspect the .docx copy and do not use docx conversion tools for this scenario. Extract these possible form fields: school, class, incident date, student placeholder name or initials, reason, suspension length, parent contact, and missing fields. Finish with the requested verification token in the final answer. Do not spawn subagents or background sessions; finish in this chat. Do not modify files, create helper scripts, or write temporary files. Do not preview or submit any form. Do not send email. Do not download attachments. Do not print secrets, tokens, Microsoft Forms URLs, full email addresses, or email bodies.
